about_the_game:
Build your manor at the bottom of your screen. Run your farm and ranch in your spare time or during breaks. Grow all kinds of crops and raise cute little animals. Keep harvesting gold coins and eventually become a wealthy manor owner.

  • Unlock different seeds in the store, grow various valuable crops, sell them to earn a large amount of gold coins, and then expand your estate!

  • Buy all kinds of animals in the store. Each animal has different breeds. Try to become a farmer who has raised all kinds of animals!

  • Before starting work, it would be a good idea to solve the Sudoku puzzle released by the store to get your brain active!

  • Set your goal to complete the collection guide!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later(64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 128 MB available space
